Separate volumes for bulk uploads and the metadata database.

## Added

- **`CONFIG_DIR` — separate the database from the uploads.** The SQLite metadata
  database can now live on its own volume, apart from the bulk uploaded files.
  Point `DATA_DIR` (`/data`) at array storage for the files and `CONFIG_DIR`
  (`/config`) at a fast SSD/appdata volume for the small database. The Unraid
  template now exposes both as separate mappings (**Data Directory** and
  **Config Directory**).

## Compatibility

- Backward-compatible. `CONFIG_DIR` defaults to `DATA_DIR`, so existing
  single-volume installs keep working unchanged — the database stays in `/data`
  until you set `CONFIG_DIR`.
- **Migrating an existing install to two volumes?** Move your current
  `db.sqlite` from the data volume into the new config volume before starting,
  or the app will create a fresh, empty database in `/config`.
